rituals.name: CONSTRAINTS ENTER BEFORE OPTIONS
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PATTERN
Boundary confusion

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
MISSION
Must-have limits should shape the field before desire fills it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Picture Safety — Picture safety, ethics, consent, resources, and timing constraints first. Push your feet down gently while you stay with the step during picture safety.
2. Eliminate — Eliminate choices that violate them.
3. Generate — Generate options only inside the surviving space. Notice which part belongs to you and which part does not during generate.
4. Treat — Treat creativity as solving within reality, not arguing with the boundary.
⚡ FINISH — Treat.
